concepts.label: A — I KNOW.
concepts.headline: I KNOW.
concepts.title: I Finally Told My Crush How I Felt
concepts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Make a polished ORIGINAL opaque 16:9 landscape YouTube storytime thumbnail for ADB EP06, "My Crush Said I Know". New composition using the four input reference images. Image 1 is the PRIMARY ADB identity and compact illustrated drawing reference, specifically ONLY the male on the left: reproduce his rounded dark navy-black ear-length curtain-hair silhouette, central triangular forehead opening, two small top flicks, narrow almond steel-blue eyes with thick angular upper eyelids, economical small angled ink nose, longer angular jaw/chin, peach skin and green collared button shirt. This is ADB, keep this recognizable face construction; do not replace him with a short-spiky-haired generic anime boy. Image 2 is the actual EP06 movie artwork and confirms canonical hair, green shirt, flat fill and economical dark ink. Image 3 supplies ONLY bold promotional graphic hierarchy, pale checkerboard, broad white heavy sans lettering with thick BLACK inner / bright RED middle / BLACK outer outlines. Image 4 supplies the approved graphic finish, white/red cutout silhouette separation and large expressive faces, NOT its characters. Do not import Nemi or her orange hair, teacher, red cup, laptop, logos or unrelated imagery from reference images. Keep illustrated flat cel fills, restrained tonal shading, expressive economical ink, NOT shiny detailed anime rendering. Every face, outline and letter must read at 320x180. Headline is the ONLY legible text, no smaller labels, UI copy, captions or watermark. Clean anatomy and prop contacts. Give text 4% safe margins. Use bright white with light pale checkerboard accents, crisp white cutout separation, selective red silhouette edges. Keep lower-right duration area free of crucial eyes and words. CONCEPT A: The smallest reply, the biggest emotional anticlimax. ADB's exceptionally large close face fills the lower RIGHT half, matching image 1's face exactly but with half-lowered eyelids, slightly raised inner brows, one tiny sweat drop and a tiny flat stunned mouth. His expression is quiet comic disbelief, NOT furious and not screaming. He looks down-left at a small dark phone held naturally in ONE hand near the lower center. On the LEFT upper/middle, a single oversized message-shaped white cutout silhouette contains the one HUGE headline verbatim "I KNOW." in broad heavy white sans with very thick black/red/black contours. This headline itself is the message; no other message lettering anywhere, no second banner. Use ample white negative space. One small deflating red heart outline by the phone is a metaphor for his nervous hope. No girl or boyfriend in this composition. Headline and his recognizable face are the two enormous graphic shapes. Pale lavender-white checker accents at corners. No busy classroom or giant phone screen. Truth: he texted his crush his feelings and got only "I know" in reply.

CONCEPT B: An awkward classroom triangle. Exact headline "SAME CLASS?!" across the upper 25%, broad extra-heavy white sans with substantial black/red/black outlines, safe margins. In foreground LEFT, large three-quarter ADB from chest up, with his same rounded curtain hair and narrow angular eyes, turning his eyes toward the right with an anxious clenched small smile, one sweat bead and an awkward raised shoulder. On RIGHT, his school crush and her boyfriend sit at adjacent simple classroom desks, smiling casually toward each other; their faces are readable but ADB remains largest. The crush is an original supporting classmate with ordinary shoulder-length chestnut hair, warm peach skin, simple dusty-mauve cardigan over white shirt; boyfriend short brown hair, plain grey-blue casual shirt. No Japanese sailor uniform, no Nemi design, no sexualized outfits. They are relaxed and unaware of ADB's awkwardness, not mocking or smirking at him. Hint at a school setting with only two desks and a small pale green chalkboard corner, against predominantly bright WHITE/pale mint checker backdrop. Use triangular character placement, clear silhouettes, no labels or arrows. No phone or calendar. Truthful promise: the class reshuffle placed ADB, his crush and her boyfriend in the same class. The visual relationship must be immediately clear.

Dramatic close composition of ADB on RIGHT, his recognizably narrow angular eyes intensely focused LEFT and his lips pulled into a nervous tiny line, blush as two economical hatch marks on each cheek, one sweat bead. No other people. Clean large face and action, fewer secondary doodles. Do not copy laptop/cup from reference.

CONCEPT D: Years of overthinking versus her innocent confusion. Exact headline "YEARS FOR THIS?!" in one visually connected broad heavy white sans headline across the top 25% with thick black/red/black contour layers and safe margins. On LEFT, chest-up ADB with his canonical rounded navy ear-length curtain hair, narrow almond eyes and green collared shirt, wearing an incredulous expression with one brow raised and a tiny disbelieving open mouth. He clutches a dramatically long accordion chain of blank calendar sheets, only simple date-square grids, cascading from his hands diagonally down-center as a clearly illustrated comic metaphor for years of wondering. On RIGHT, an original supporting school crush with ordinary shoulder-length chestnut hair, simple dusty-mauve cardigan over white shirt, large puzzled eyes and gently raised palms in an innocent confused shrug, NOT smug or laughing. Her head and ADB's head must be large and their gaze connects. No boyfriend. One single question-mark symbol above her shoulder, no extra text. Bright white background with pale mint checker edge accents and minimal graphic clutter. Truth: she did not remember BLOCKING him; do NOT imply she forgot who he was or that she rejected his confession. Calendar pages have no numerals or words. Keep calendars subordinate to the expressive faces; clean grips and natural wrists.
